title: GTA6 Shadows the Industry, But Galaxies Showcase Delivers Surprises
description: As the games industry clears the runway for GTA6, the recent Galaxies Showcase proves there is still plenty to get excited about this autumn.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA6 Effect: Clearing the Runway

You can smell it in the air, can't you? The chill in your nostrils, the earthy scent of falling leaves, and the departure of the sun for another year. Yes, autumn is officially here, and with it comes a familiar industry phenomenon. We are currently teetering on the cavernous hole of near-nothingness as the entire games industry gives Grand Theft Auto 6 the widest berth imaginable.

While Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster continues to loom large over the release calendar, shaping how publishers schedule their biggest titles, the industry hasn't completely ground to a halt. In fact, developers and publishers are still finding clever ways to capture player attention during a period heavily dominated by the anticipation of GTA6.

## Highlights from the Galaxies Showcase

Fortunately, a lack of industry-wide blockbusters doesn't mean a complete drought of excitement. The latest edition of the Galaxies Showcase has stepped up to toss a few more items onto the collective "ooooh intriguing!" pile.

Spanning nearly two hours in runtime, the showcase delivered a surprisingly dense lineup of announcements. While viewers always have the option to watch the full presentation from start to finish, media outlets and fans alike have been busy sifting through the highlights to spotlight the projects that truly stand out. Of course, whether all of this excitement was merely an elaborate excuse for Connor to enthuse about penguins is a question best left unanswered, but it certainly added plenty of personality to the proceedings.

For gamers weathering the long wait for GTA6, events like the Galaxies Showcase serve as a welcome reminder that there is a diverse ecosystem of games bubbling just beneath the surface of the mainstream giants.

## Editor's Take
It is fascinating to watch the gaming industry collectively hold its breath and clear the stage for GTA6. Yet, showcases like this prove that creativity thrives even in the shadows of giants. While we wait for Rockstar's next masterpiece, these smaller surprises keep the autumn gaming season vibrant and full of unexpected delights.
